The Breakdown & Plane Error:

State actors execute smart selfish security maneuvers, using cartel violence as a pretext to expand military powers while projecting cooperation as purely altruistic.

The Unavoidable Lie: Militarized crackdowns operate cleanly without compromising civil liberties, local sovereignty, or human rights.
